content.text:
**Finding: deviation (§ 11.1)** — redline validated and submitted.

- **§ 11.2 / § 11.3 are fine**: 30-day return in a documented machine-readable format, no withholding for fee disputes, and officer-certified secure deletion after confirmed return — these already satisfy the preferred position on data return and deletion certification.
- **§ 11.1 fails the fallback**: it requires Vendor to discontinue all assistance *immediately* on termination and to permanently delete Customer Data with no export or migration support. That is walk-away language (no data return / immediate deletion) and it also directly contradicts §§ 11.2–11.3.
- **Fix**: § 11.1 replaced with up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates including export/migration support, with deletion deferred to §§ 11.2–11.3; 90 days offered as the fallback in the comment.
